findings.title: Index job reports SUCCEEDED on partial failure, RUNNING never observable, no job listing
findings.reachability: POST /api/v1/admin/ai/knowledge/sources/{id}/sync (@RequiresPermission admin:ai:knowledge:sync) -> synchronous syncSource in one @Transactional
findings.impact: Admin sees success while documents failed; failed document state invisible; job history not queryable; 'submitted' wording contradicts synchronous behavior
findings.fix_hint: Add PARTIAL/FAILED semantics, commit RUNNING before work, add paginated job list, align DDL default with IndexJobStatus

findings.title: Retrieval loads all chunks of all enabled sources with no bound; ai_knowledge_chunk lacks source_id index
findings.reachability: Every chat invoke (retrieveKnowledge) and the qa doc-search tool call knowledgeService.search
findings.impact: Latency/heap grow with knowledge-base size; concurrent chats are an OOM surface; no document READY filter so stale chunks of failed documents are still recalled
findings.fix_hint: Add index on (source_id[, document_id]); project only needed columns; bound candidates before loading content; two-stage retrieval

findings.title: min_score is persisted/editable but never applied; code default 30 vs DB default 0.2 are different scales
findings.reachability: PUT /api/v1/admin/ai/agent-versions/{versionId}/knowledge stores minScore; retrieval path has zero references to it
findings.impact: Admin tuning has no effect; noise chunks with a single 2-gram hit become citations; future enforcement would behave differently for seeded (30) vs API-created (0.2) bindings
findings.fix_hint: Unify scale, filter in rankChunks by binding.minScore, add DTO range validation, migrate legacy 0.2

findings.title: syncMode (MANUAL/AUTO) is a dead configuration: written and echoed, never read
findings.reachability: grep over com.astral.ai finds no getSyncMode call and no @Scheduled; only setters and VO assembly
findings.impact: Selecting AUTO does nothing; knowledge silently goes stale since sync is manual-only
findings.fix_hint: Implement a scheduler keyed on syncMode/lastSyncTime, or remove/mark the field as reserved

findings.title: Reindex deletes chunks before reinserting and swallows per-document exceptions, producing zero-chunk documents with stale counters
findings.reachability: syncSource (admin sync endpoint and startup seed) calls reindexDocument per document inside one transaction with catch-and-continue
findings.impact: Document can lose all chunks while chunk_count/status stay stale; combined with K-01 the job still reports success
findings.fix_hint: Write new chunks before deleting old ones (or per-document transaction), set document FAILED on error, expose error summary

findings.title: Knowledge listing reads full TEXT content then discards it; per-source N+1; no pagination
findings.impact: Slow admin page and unnecessary heap/DB load proportional to document bodies (up to 400k chars each)
findings.fix_hint: Explicit column projection excluding content; persist chunk totals or aggregate once; paginate

findings.title: Content silently truncated at 400,000 chars; no @Size validation, no notice, hash computed on truncated body
findings.impact: Tail of large documents lost silently; content_hash no longer corresponds to the source document, breaking citation traceability
findings.fix_hint: Add @Size(max) and reject, or return an explicit truncated flag; move the limit to configuration

findings.title: Duplicate bindings cause a unique-index violation rendered as HTTP 500; citationPolicy/sourceType/syncMode accept values outside dictionary/enum
findings.reachability: PUT /api/v1/admin/ai/agent-versions/{versionId}/knowledge (body list) and POST/PUT knowledge sources
findings.impact: Unreadable 500 for duplicate source ids; dictionary-external source types silently fall out of QaToolProvider sourceTypes filtering
findings.fix_hint: Deduplicate bindings server-side; whitelist-validate enum-ish fields; throw business exceptions (300/320) instead of DB constraint errors

findings.title: No index-job listing, no knowledge-source deletion, jobs accumulate per application start
findings.reachability: Controller has only GET index-jobs/{jobId}; service exposes no deleteSource/listJobs/cancel
findings.impact: No cleanup, no failure history, no cancel of an accidental full reindex; one extra job row plus full reindex on every boot
findings.fix_hint: Add paginated job list + retention, add source delete with cascade, skip seed sync when content hash is unchanged

findings.title: hasReadyKnowledge only checks enabled bindings but is used as a readiness/capability flag
findings.impact: Capability advertised while retrieval returns empty (bound source disabled or empty); name/behavior mismatch
findings.fix_hint: Check source enabled + READY documents + chunk count, or rename to hasEnabledBinding

findings.title: sha256 silently degrades to String.hashCode() on exception; raw exception messages persisted to error_summary
findings.reachability: Document save path and sync job error summary surfaced through IndexJobVo
findings.impact: Collision-prone 32-bit hash silently replaces SHA-256, breaking content identity; error_summary carries raw driver/SQL text (admin-visible only)
findings.fix_hint: Fail fast (or log.error + null) on digest failure; store error codes plus document keys, keep details in logs

findings.title: refreshSourceCounters issues a redundant chunk COUNT whose result only reaches the log
findings.impact: Wasted COUNT per save; chunk totals are instead recomputed in the controller by loading all documents
findings.fix_hint: Drop the redundant COUNT or add a chunk_count column and write it back; aggregate for listings

residual_limitations: No mvn compile/test, Spotless, Checkstyle, SpotBugs executed; all findings are static source evidence.
No backend started, no DB connection, no HTTP request; the missing-index conclusion for K-02 is a DDL fact, but no EXPLAIN plan was captured.
No browser/frontend verification of the admin knowledge page behavior implied by K-01/K-06.
AiChatOrchestrator (1805 lines) and AdminToolProvider (1165 lines) were NOT audited as full targets; only the cited fragments were read.
Not covered: prompt/model/quota/approval, AI request-message persistence, MCP/HTTP tool transport, frontend AI pages.
Lead's in-flight fixes (Orchestrator requester permission groups, always-approval for HIGH, AiAdminRequestController metadata split) were not touched and are not judged here.
